title: The direct image of a coherent module along a finite morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme is coherent
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] with $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent] (for instance $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_Y$). Then $f_*\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$, with $f^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}B$, $(f_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(f^{-1}U)$ is a finite $R$-module. (Stacks' statement also gives $R^pf_*\mathcal F=0$ for $p>0$; that part is not stated here.)

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y6 (lemma-finite-pushforward-coherent), coherence part, with Lemma 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian)
